articles.title: Crypto wallets are being rebuilt for AI agents, Trust Wallet and Mesh executives say at Consensus Miami
articles.snippet: Trust Wallet CEO Felix Fan and Mesh CTO Arjun Mukherjee said AI agents are creating a new role for crypto wallets.

articles.title: Strike CEO Jack Mallers dismisses idea that Wall Street threatens Bitcoin
articles.snippet: Strike CEO Jack Mallers argued that if Wall Street “kills” Bitcoin, then the asset was never going to succeed in the first place.

articles.title: Estonia's FSA issues investor warning about Zondacrypto
articles.snippet: The news follows an investigation into the crypto exchange by Polish law enforcement officials and reports of customer withdrawal issues.

articles.title: Exodus launches AI agent-focused stablecoin on Solana
articles.snippet: The crypto wallet company pairs the XO Cash token with software tools that let AI agents transact using preset spending controls and stablecoin payments.

articles.title: Crypto Biz: Wall Street wants more than just Bitcoin
articles.snippet: Institutional capital is returning to crypto as Bitcoin ETFs surge, prediction markets mature and banks accelerate tokenized finance adoption.
